Definition: to puncture, literally (to perforate, with more or less violence) or figuratively (to specify, designate, libel)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to pierce, perforate, bore, appoint; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to pierce, bore; 1a2) to prick off, designate; 1b) (Niphal) to be pricked off, be designated, be specified; 2) (Qal) to curse, blaspheme
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
